known_issues.issue: These three dimensions repeat one placeholder record (indicator “Regional environmental baseline”, value “Compliant with state limits”, source “EPA / NOAA Region 9”) rather than a measurement each, and each is scored 0 (within target).
Freshwater withdrawals reports 42 gallons per person per day against a target of 45, which is within target, yet carries an overshoot level of 42.
Peace & justice names its source as “Projected Synthesis”, a projection rather than a published measurement.
Source links go to publishers’ home or section pages, not to the cited documents, so no figure can be traced to the page it came from.
